system.description:
You gain a +3 bonus to [Recovery].
You always have [Weakness (Flame): 10].
This item can be equipped by Druids.

It's a shield made by attaching a handle to a leaf from a giant tree monster. Despite its simple design, it offers high defense against both physical and magical attacks, but its weakness to fire is a drawback.

  • Leaf of Life [Core Material] (40G)
  • Buckler (50G)
  • [Magic Catalyst 2] (20G) × 3
  • Crafting Cost (70G)
